history.critique: The R12 round partly worked. In m02 front, m06 shoulders-front and trunk-front, the light horizontal band across the upper chest is gone, and so are the small ledges at both shoulder tips. No new crease appeared. On the ear fan, the jagged shards and rim spikes are merged into fewer, rounder lumps, and the flakes on the rear of the fan are gone. The fan now sits closer to the body's level of development. Front ear span is unchanged at 0.524 of figure height (reference 0.521). Three things still hurt coherence. First, the bright flat rectangular facet on the upper arm, with a hard lower edge, is unchanged in m02 left and m07 forearm-profile, so half of the order's seam issue remains. Second, the smooth skull disc with its circular rim still shows from behind. Third, the fan is calmer but reads as amorphous cauliflower lumps rather than m01's tapered feathered locks. One side effect: left-view depth at the 0.34 to 0.38 rows fell from about 0.148 to 0.140 to 0.145 of figure height (reference 0.149 to 0.176, partly the posed arm). Regions that changed: R05 rose from 5 to 6 (shoulder ledges and chest band gone) and R12 from 5 to 6. R03 and R04 changed visibly (less noise) but hold their scores, because lock structure and rear depth are still missing. R01's crown softening is within noise. R08 to R11 are identical apart from render noise. The weakest regions are still R03, R04, R06 (front waist 0.20 against 0.13 to 0.15), R07 and R11.
